seo.title: Social Media Strategy & Planning | CloudTopia
seo.description: A clear social media strategy — audience, channels, content pillars, and a plan that actually drives results. Free consultation.

hero.subtitle: Stop posting randomly. We build a focused strategy — audience, channels, content pillars, and goals — so every post has a purpose.

items.title: Audience & channels
items.description: We define who you are reaching and where they actually are.

items.title: Content pillars
items.description: Clear themes that keep your content consistent and on-brand.

items.title: Measurable goals
items.description: KPIs tied to real outcomes, not just likes.

items.title: You own everything
items.description: The store/accounts, code, data, and documentation stay with you — no lock-in.

faqs.question: What does the strategy include?
faqs.answer: Audience research, channel selection, content pillars, posting cadence, tone, and measurable goals — a practical plan your team or ours can execute.

faqs.question: Will it fit our industry?
faqs.answer: Yes — the strategy is built around your specific market, audience, and goals in the GCC, not a generic template.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
